t: A south Indian kingdom ruled by the Wodeyar dynasty, which grew from a Vijayanagara vassal into a regional power.
Under Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan it built a modern army with French-trained infantry and iron-cased rockets.
It fought four wars with the East India Company and fell when Srirangapatna was stormed in 1799.
dyk: Tipu's Tiger, a wooden automaton of a tiger attacking a European soldier that contains a small organ, was taken from Srirangapatna and is now in the V&A in London.
ev: Yaduraya founds the Wodeyar dynasty, according to tradition
Raja Wodeyar I takes Srirangapatna and makes it his capital
Hyder Ali takes control of the government
Hyder Ali destroys a British detachment at the Battle of Pollilur
The Treaty of Mangalore ends the Second Anglo-Mysore War
Tipu Sultan cedes half his territory in the Treaty of Seringapatam
British forces storm Srirangapatna and Tipu Sultan is killed
